name: Kottu Roti
description: Shredded roti stir-fried with egg, vegetables, and a blend of spices. A Sri Lankan street-food classic that hits different after a long lecture.

name: Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed rice with mixed vegetables, egg, and soy sauce. Filling, fast, and perfect for a busy campus day.

name: Veg Sub
description: Toasted sub roll loaded with fresh vegetables, cheese, and a tangy sauce. Back soon — check again tomorrow!

name: Watalappan
description: A traditional Sri Lankan coconut custard steamed with jaggery and cardamom. Sweet, creamy, and a little bit of home.

name: Iced Milo
description: Cold Milo over ice — the campus canteen staple. Chocolatey, malty, and exactly what you need between classes.
